worldcombat.skill.psychocut.summary: A blade of solidified psychic power is formed in front of the user and thrown; it steers itself toward the target and cuts a cross in the vertical plane at the hit, pinning the target on the crossing while the edge wind catches nearby foes. A homing ranged slash with the family's raised critical chance.
The blade deals %1$s slicing damage and lands critical hits more often.
The blade flies at %1$s blocks per tick over %2$s blocks, steering up to %3$s degrees per tick toward the target.
The cross at the hit is %1$s blocks in radius, and nearby foes take %2$s of the edge wind.
worldcombat.skill.psychocut.keen.on: Keen form: a heavier blade, a bigger cross and a stronger wind, at slower flight and a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.psychocut.keen.off: Swift form: faster flight and a shorter cooldown, at lower power and a smaller cross.
worldcombat.skill.psychocut.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.psychocut.growth.0: From level %1$s the blade rises to %2$s and the cross to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.psychocut.growth.1: From level %1$s the blade rises to %2$s, the range to %3$s blocks and the wind to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.psychocut.use.0: Throw a blade of solidified psychic power
worldcombat.skill.psychocut.use.1: The blade steers itself toward the target
worldcombat.skill.psychocut.use.2: The cross at the hit catches nearby foes
worldcombat.skill.psychocut.preference.k: On: 112% power, 0.35 blocks more cross and 0.06 more wind, at 85% flight speed and +8 cooldown. Off: 115% flight speed and -6 cooldown, at 94% power and 0.2 blocks less cross.
worldcombat.skill.psychocut.preference.a: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of throwing. Larger values throw from further away.
On: below 45% health a target is thrown at first to finish it. Off: it ranks the blade as an ordinary ranged slash whatever the health.
